defect: The fix only removes the unused I18NCategory variable l (and adds a default case elsewhere) to silence compiler warnings.
reason: An unused local added by this change is a warning/style issue, not a functional defect.

defect: Adding the stackAddr member to DisplayList changed the layout of a struct that GPUCommon::DoState serializes with DoArray, without bumping the savestate section version, breaking loading of older savestates.
reason: The fix bumps the GPUCommon section to version 3 and adds a DisplayList_v2 compatibility path precisely for the member this change added.

defect: In VIRTKEY_NEXT_SLOT the change wrote NetworkWarnUserIfOnlineAndCantSavestate() without the negation, so next-slot only works when online savestates are blocked.
reason: The fix adds exactly the missing '!' on the line this change introduced, unlike all the sibling cases.

defect: The fix re-indents the Cardboard settings block (spaces to tabs) and moves it lower in the graphics settings list.
reason: Indentation and menu placement are style/UI organisation, not a defect.

defect: NativeKeyboard allocates input with new char[] and then uses ARRAY_SIZE(input) on the pointer (and sizeof(input) in memset), so the bound is the pointer size, not FieldMaxLength().
reason: The fix replaces ARRAY_SIZE(input) with FieldMaxLength() in the loop this change added.

defect: The change only encodes the light types into the vertex shader ID when lighting is enabled, but shade mapping (UV gen mode 2) still uses the light types for LIGHT_DOTONLY lights, so different shaders collide on one ID.
reason: The fix extends the condition to (lightingEnable || getUVGenMode() == 2) on the gating line this change added; GenerateVertexShader in the same diff shows the light types used for shade mapping.

defect: The fix adds parsing and handling of single-document content URIs (content://provider/document/...) used by the Load... button.
reason: At this change the class was only used by PathBrowser for tree URIs; single-file document URIs reached it only through later scoped-storage code, so the fix extends it to a new input form.

defect: The fix renames and extends the AndroidContentURI unit test with a non-tree single-file URI case.
reason: This is a test change accompanying a parser extension, not a repair of a defect in the test lines.

defect: Setting chanQueueMinSizeFactor to 0 makes __AudioEnqueue compute blockSamples = size / 2 / chanQueueMinSizeFactor, an integer division by zero.
reason: The fix (titled divide by zero) sets chanQueueMinSizeFactor back to 1; the division is elsewhere in the file and not in the shown diff.

defect: Narrowing the reset condition to fpsLimit != 0 makes EmuScreen::update force fpsLimit back to 0 every frame, breaking the button that toggles fpsLimit to 1.
reason: The fix restores fpsLimit 1 as an allowed value in the condition this change altered; the diff shows previously allowed values now being reset.

defect: The fix restructures the fragment shader ID (texture bits only when texturing, color test bits, fog moved to bit 15 using enableFog) and other shader issues.
reason: Moving fog to bit 12 removed an overlap and was correct; the missing color-test bits and raw fogEnable use predate this change.

defect: The fix reverts the change's unsigned reading of the Z component in through mode back to signed.
reason: Unsigned through-mode Z is the hardware behaviour, reinstated later (79549e4, bc6a67b) and still in the current decoder, so the reverted lines were not a defect.

defect: The fix makes lmode depend on lightingEnable and gates light bits in the vertex shader ID.
reason: This change forced lmode to 0; the secondary-color logic the fix corrects came from later rewrites of the generator.

defect: The OSK navigation added here moves by 10 for up/down (rows are 12 keys wide, and up/down are reversed) and wraps at 44 instead of the 48 valid keys.
reason: The fix replaces the +/-10 steps and the 44 wrap bounds introduced by this change with KEYSPERROW-based movement and modulo wrapping.

defect: The new System_MakeRequest returns bool but has no return statement after the switch, so control falls off the end of a non-void function (undefined behaviour).
reason: The fix adds return true for INPUT_TEXT_MODAL and default: return false; the wrong-thread dialog call it also fixes was pre-existing, as the change's own comment says.

defect: In this file the fix only renames ReleaseSpillLocks() to ReleaseSpillLocksAndDiscardTemps().
reason: The called function body is unchanged by the rename, so the line this change wrote behaves the same.

defect: Where it touches this change's lines the fix renames MapRegsV to MapRegsAndSpillLockV and drops redundant early or trailing ReleaseSpillLocks calls; its real bug fixes are in prefix and clamping code added later.
reason: The early spill-lock releases in lv.s/sv.s/lv.q/sv.q and VDot are followed by no further FPU mapping, so they cause no wrong code.

defect: The fix makes MapInIn/MapDirtyIn/MapDirtyInIn release only their own spill locks instead of calling ReleaseSpillLocks, which by then also discarded all temps.
reason: At this change ReleaseSpillLocks only cleared locks (the same idiom as the GPR cache); the harm came from 5a09885 adding temp discarding to it.

defect: The fix renames ReleaseSpillLocks and MapRegsV to ReleaseSpillLocksAndDiscardTemps and MapRegsAndSpillLockV in the header.
reason: Renaming declarations is an API clarification, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix re-enables MASKED_PSP_MEMORY on iOS after finding that a shader generator bug, not masking, caused the breakage.
reason: It is a configuration toggle reverted after an experiment; disabling masking on iOS was not shown to be a defect.

defect: The change reads back every framebuffer younger than FBO_OLD_AGE on every second frame, dropping the age == 0 and !memoryUpdated guards, so stale framebuffers are repeatedly copied over memory.
reason: The fix, titled a regression fix, restores exactly the condition this change replaced.

defect: The fix only adds an (int) cast and a size_t loop index to silence signed/unsigned comparison warnings in TextEdit::Key.
reason: The comparisons were correct in practice; this is warning cleanup.

defect: The fix replaces resizeEvent with resizeGL and adds x/y scale members to handle retina resolution.
reason: This change only moved the definitions out of the header with identical behaviour; the retina sizing problem was pre-existing.

defect: ScrollView::Touch assigns the unclamped drag position to scrollPos_ and clamps it only at the end, so the render thread can briefly see a position past the end and flicker.
reason: The fix (flicker at end) clamps the new position before assigning it; touches arrive on the Android UI thread while drawing runs on the GL thread, which the diff does not show.

defect: In the header the fix replaces the ClampScrollTarget() declaration with ClampScrollPos(float &pos).
reason: Generalising the clamp helper is a refactor; ClampScrollTarget correctly clamped scrollTarget_.

defect: The contents of dialog.cpp and dialog.h are swapped: the .cpp holds only '#pragma once' and prototypes, and the non-inline definitions sit in the header, so any second includer gets duplicate-symbol link errors.
reason: The fix moves the definitions into dialog.cpp and reduces dialog.h to declarations.

defect: round_vfpu_n takes a float but is called with the double sv, so the clamped 0x7fffffff becomes 2^31 (int overflow to 0x80000000) and large values lose precision before rounding.
reason: The fix changes the round_vfpu_n parameter from float to double (and clamps before converting); the float signature was added by this change.

defect: The fix redoes the x86 JIT vf2i clamp and multiply in double precision (float cannot hold 0x7fffffff) and re-enables the instruction.
reason: The JIT's wrong out-of-range vf2i results predate this change, which disabled the path because its float-clamp attempt failed, so its new lines never ran.

defect: ApplyTextureDepal multiplies the vertex bounds by texWidth/texHeight although KnownVertexBounds are already pixel coordinates, so the depal scissor and blit rectangle are wrong.
reason: The fix removes the * texWidth / * texHeight from exactly the lines this change added; the pixel-space meaning of vertBounds is defined outside the diff.

defect: The fix replaces the integer modulo used for snap-to-grid with fmod so fractional positions snap exactly.
reason: The (int)...% snapping expressions were context lines already present before this change, which only renamed the drag-start variables.

defect: sceMpegGetPcmAu checks the std::map find result with the MSVC-internal member streamInfo._Ptr, which does not compile with libstdc++ on Linux.
reason: The fix replaces it with the portable comparison streamInfo == ctx->streamMap.end() on the line this change added.

defect: The fix forces an 8888 texture format when the texture will be saved and decodes with actualFmt, since the replacer only saves 8888 data.
reason: 16-bit replacement formats were removed later (ef4a6cf, 2022-07-29); at this change saving 16-bit decoded data was still supported.

defect: The non-SIMD Mul4x4By4x4 fallback indexes b.m[i*4+k] * a.m[k*4+j] for result.m[j*4+i], which yields a transposed product with column-major storage.
reason: The fix corrects the index expression in this loop, which this change added (its commit title already calls the fallback buggy).

defect: The fix scales alpha by 255.99 instead of 256.0 so that stencil value 255 (alpha 1.0) does not become 256 and get discarded.
reason: The * 256.0 scaling existed before; this change only switched the shader from uint to int.

defect: UpdateMenus gains a second zoom loop comparing i == iWindowZoom (off by one) that overrides the correct i == iWindowZoom - 1 check, so the wrong zoom item is checked.
reason: The fix deletes exactly the duplicate loop this change added; the correct loop is visible just above it.

defect: The legacy mapping loop now ORs input.pad_buttons_down & mapping[i][0] (PAD_BUTTON bits) into pressed instead of the PSP CTRL bit mapping[i][1], scrambling legacy input.
reason: The fix sets pressed |= mapping[i][1] when the pad button is down, on the line this change wrote.

defect: listStatus was switched to DisplayListQueue::const_iterator with cbegin()/cend(), C++11 library members missing on a supported toolchain, causing a compile error.
reason: The fix titled fixed compiling error reverts exactly this line to begin()/end(); which toolchain lacks cbegin is build configuration outside the diff.

defect: The fix stops writing per-step timestamps once MAX_TIMESTAMP_QUERIES would be exceeded.
reason: The unbounded per-step vkCmdWriteTimestamp existed before this change, which only moved the query pool and descriptions into a QueueProfileContext.

defect: The fix moves MAX_TIMESTAMP_QUERIES to namespace scope (value 128) so the queue runner can bound its timestamp writes.
reason: This change wrote only two or three timestamps per frame; the overflow came with per-step timestamps added later, so the header edit is a refactor and limit tweak.

defect: rebalance now calls realloc with the old capacity and then doubles capacity, so the queue writes past the end of its buffer (heap corruption).
reason: The fix passes capacity * 2 to realloc in the code this change introduced.
